text:
DeployBot: starting rollout v4.3.0 -> prod. Canary: 8% per region (usw1, use1, euw2). Observability: embeddings-service p95 elevated only in euw2 canaries. Autorevert: ON but set to cross-region threshold. Recommend human review for region-scoped actions.
Hana: ack. Confirming: only euw2 shows spike; usw1/use1 are normal.
Priya: logs from euw2 canaries show KV sync lag and sporadic 503s. Looks like a networking flap on the euw2 test hosts. Not confident a full revert is required.
OpsMarco: ops note: we can either 1) full revert globally, 2) pin embeddings route in euw2 back to v4.2.9, or 3) pause rollout in euw2 and hold others. Prefer targeted fix to avoid rollbacks elsewhere.
SRE_Anya: agree with targeted region pin. If it's infra networking, isolating region avoids customer impact in other regions. We'll keep elevated alerts for cross-region spillover.
Legal_Josh: heads up: if we pin regionally and it affects enterprise customers on dedicated pools in eu, coordinate legal/compliance comms. Might need to log incident for audit.
Sales_Mary: I have two EU enterprise seats on standby; ping me list and I'll outreach if we plan a routing change.
Priya: ops command to set a regional override (suggested):
```
# pin embeddings route in euw2 to stable
redwoodctl route override --route embeddings --version v4.2.9 --region euw2 --reason "canary euw2 latency regression" --expires 60m
```
DeployBot: NOTE: regional overrides require Ops + SRE confirmation during change window. Cutoff for automated revert is 3491234610.
OpsMarco: executing region pin now; SRE_Anya please confirm.
OpsMarco: /run redwoodctl route override --route embeddings --version v4.2.9 --region euw2 --reason "manual-region-pin-canary" --expires 60m
SRE_Anya: confirming override. Approved.
DeployBot: action accepted: embeddings route pinned to v4.2.9 in euw2 by OpsMarco at 3491234602. Canary traffic for v4.3.0 in euw2 reduced to 0% for embeddings.
Hana: monitoring euw2 45s later p95 back to baseline. No error spike in other regions.
Priya: creating revert PR for the runtime change (repo@commit g12h34) as backup. Linking to incident.
Sales_Mary: please share customer advisory draft; I'll route to EU enterprise contacts after Product review.
Legal_Josh: I'll log the override and add a note to the incident record for compliance.
SRE_Anya: setting watch for 45m. If p95 rises above 1.3x baseline in any region, we'll consider extending the pin or initiating a full rollback.
OpsMarco: added release metadata note: "regional override: embeddings pinned to v4.2.9 in euw2 due to canary latency spike; investigating network layer on euw2 hosts."
Hana: drafting postmortem stub and assigning owners to infra + runtime teams.
ProductCW: (via DM) approve customer advisory language: "We routed embeddings traffic in EU region to a previously stable runtime after a performance regression was observed during canary. No data loss. We're investigating and will update."
Sales_Mary: approved, sending to contacts now.
Priya: override expires at 3491234962 unless extended. I'll run staging repro with simulated network delays and KV pressure.
SRE_Anya: if repro succeeds, plan is patch infra networking config and redeploy patched v4.3.0 to euw2 canary, then lift override.
DeployBot: archived action and events under incident/INC-2026-049.
Hana: closing thread; will follow up in postmortems channel once root cause known.
DeployBot: thread closed by OpsMarco at 3491234649.
